brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, wide 16:9 composition, target 1920x1080 or larger, opaque PNG.

Use the approved black/lime thumbnail style already viewed in this conversation only as a visual style guide: near-black #151A18 ground, electric lime #CCF43B energetic broad dry-brush marks, warm off-white heavy Japanese sans-serif headlines, black ink and hand-painted brush illustration, restrained grain, very few elements. Do not transfer any player, number, name, score, or date from those style references.

Content basis: the supplied fixed article is titled 11/27 試合結果・当日のEFF and covers B.ONE games and daily position-specific EFF TOP3. This is a general article thumbnail, NOT a particular player's performance feature.

Layout: left 54% is crisp readable typography with generous spacing; right 46% is an expressive athletic illustration, waist-up to upper thighs, of the REAL player Cheick Keita (シェイク・ケイタ), chosen randomly from names in the article. Use the official portrait seen in this conversation as appearance reference only. His specific appearance: dark brown skin, broad plain black headband across forehead, short black twisted locks extending just above headband and at temples, long oval face with defined jaw, broad nose, full lips, dark focused eyes, very faint moustache and small short goatee below lower lip/chin, clean cheeks. Tall muscular shoulders and arms. Preserve these recognizable features; do not invent another athlete. The face should be clearly visible with readable contours and highlights, not lost in a black silhouette.

Pose: dynamic three-quarter front view, knees slightly flexed and torso turning in a strong pivot, holding one orange basketball securely at upper chest/shoulder level with BOTH anatomically correct hands. Two arms only, clear natural wrists and five fingers per hand, no duplicate hands. The ball and head must be completely inside the frame. A generic imagined basketball movement, no reenactment of an actual game moment. Plain dark emerald and black sleeveless basketball jersey over a black short-sleeve compression top, with subtle ivory edge accents; absolutely NO lettering, NO team/league/sponsor logos, NO numbers, NO marks on ball, NO opponent, NO photorealism, NO photo collage. Render everything as bold expressive hand-inked sports illustration with visible brush texture, matching the approved style.

Exact text to render, and ONLY this text:
Top-left small: 「バスケまとめ」
Below small: 「B.ONE」
Large left headline, two stacked lines: 「11/27」 then 「試合結果」
Below in lime, prominent: 「当日のEFF」
Below smaller off-white: 「ポジション別TOP3」
Along the bottom-left with clear space and comfortable margin: 「イラスト（AI生成）」 and 「イメージ」

Do not render the Japanese quote brackets. All text must be exact, fully readable and unclipped, Japanese characters correct. Maintain a 5% safety margin. Do not add a player's name, player stats, a game score, an achievement claim or a claim that this illustrates his actual appearance on the date. The AI label and イメージ must remain legible on a quiet dark area. High-impact, tasteful, spare composition with the lime brush stroke sweeping diagonally behind the athlete without touching the text.

generator.inspection: 内蔵生成結果の表示を実見し、保存元PNGもview_imageで確認。文字・日付・EFFの対象範囲・本人の容姿の特徴・2本の腕とボールを抱える手・顔とボールの見切れ・下部注記を確認。写真風表現、ロゴ、スポンサー文字なし。
